method.method_draft: Introduce P as the intersection of AB with the horizontal line and Q as the intersection of the slanted ray from B with the horizontal line. Use vertical angles at Q to get angle 4 = 40°. Then in triangle PBQ, angle 5 = 180° - 76° - 40° = 64°. From the text condition AB ⟂ BC, the angle at B between BA and BC is 90°, so angle 5 + angle 6 = 90°. Therefore angle 6 = 90° - 64° = 26°.
